title: DevTeam Task
description: Canonical schema for docs/planning/tasks/TASK-XXX.json, produced by agents/planning/task-graph-analyzer.md. Unifies the two schemas that previously diverged: commands/devteam-plan.md's inline complexity-score-based version and task-graph-analyzer.md's hours-based version (which defined no JSON schema at all). Both dimensions are kept (Phase 1 of docs/reviews/ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT_2026-08-26.md, Roadmap Phase 1) since complexity.score drives .devteam/model-selection.md's per-attempt model pick and estimated_hours drives agents/planning/sprint-planner.md's sprint/track balancing.

id.description: e.g. TASK-001. Zero-padded to at least 3 digits; grows past 999 without changing format.

feature_ref.description: References a requirement id from prd.schema.json's requirements.must_have/should_have (REQ-XXX), not the legacy features.json FEAT-XXX id space — see prd.schema.json's description for why REQ- is canonical.

task_type.description: Union of every task_type value found in commands/devteam-plan.md (backend|frontend|database|fullstack|testing|infrastructure) and agents/planning/task-graph-analyzer.md (fullstack|backend|frontend|database|python-generic|infrastructure), plus 'design' and 'data_architecture' added per the audit's Phase 1 (closes the gap in Architecture Audit §5 where no task_type value could ever route to a design agent). .devteam/model-selection.md's calculate_complexity() type_scores map now recognizes every value in this enum ('python-generic', 'infrastructure' at weight 2; 'design' at weight 1; 'data_architecture' at weight 3, matching 'architecture') -- the soft gap noted in earlier drafts of this schema is closed.

complexity.description: Feeds .devteam/model-selection.md's calculate_complexity()/select_model() directly — field names below match that algorithm's inputs exactly.

score.description: Computed by .devteam/model-selection.md's calculate_complexity(); 0-14, clamped with min(score, 14). Callers MAY leave this for the model-selection step to compute, but when present it must be internally consistent with `factors`.

risk_flags.description: Only these three values add to the complexity score in model-selection.md; other strings are accepted here for forward-compatibility but are currently ignored by the scorer.

estimated_hours.description: Added per Architecture Audit Phase 1 (previously only implied by task-graph-analyzer.md's prose 'Task Sizing: 1-2 days maximum (4-16 hours)', never a JSON field). Consumed by agents/planning/sprint-planner.md's balanced track-assignment algorithm, which sums this field per dependency chain. No hard maximum is enforced here — 4-16 is the typical/recommended range, not a contract.

dependencies.description: IDs of tasks that must complete before this one starts. Must not contain this task's own id (no self-dependency) and must not form a cycle across the full task set — both are structural checks the generating agent performs, not expressible in this per-document schema.

suggested_agent.description: category:agent-id, matching an id in agent-registry.json (e.g. 'backend:api-developer-python', 'frontend:developer'). For task_type 'design', this should resolve to a ux:* agent per Architecture Audit §10.2's design-task-precedes-UI-task rule.
